posts.summary: The mechanism end to end — the runaway, the cliff, and why the state it lands in cannot see itself.
Who is at risk: anxiety-proneness read as low damping, and the cheap test — tolerance, not settling time — that would settle it.
The rescue result: a cheap fixed floor beats an elaborate one — and re-checking your support is what destroys it.
A full rescue buys the recovered state nothing against the next trigger — the threshold restored is the threshold the next episode drains.
The same collapse run deliberately — Schein, Lifton, Stein — and the inversion: the same three guardrails, two of them flipped.
Why “the observer collapses reality” and “union with God” are one move — and how the frame steers the collapse to an owned destination.
The person at the top: leader and follower share one dissociation pointing opposite ways — the group as his externalized self.
The follower is a position, not a personality — seventy years of research tried to name the type and dissolved it instead. Expression is conditional; the instrument failed at .20.
Seven contemplative traditions, with no contact with each other, named this failure and prescribed the same five safeguards — primary-source passages.

What the traditions that survive the collapse wrote down — ethics first, metered pace, plural community, a teacher who points past himself, discernment as procedure — and why the clinical field is re-deriving the same list.
"Cult" is a category that does harm — to the people it is meant to protect — and the sources this series leans on helped justify kidnapping. Why it names mechanisms instead.
The levers without the mysticism: a masonic lodge and a false-bottomed suitcase run the same structure as the mystics — so the lever is a position, not a belief.
The unfalsifiable authority without a person: Horizon, Robodebt and the Dutch childcare affair — and the finding that measurement is not a safeguard, auditable measurement is.
The clinic in the model: the state is ambiguous by construction, the instruments false-positive, and the honest measure is impairment, duration — and a holder.
The state cannot initiate its own exit: an outside relationship is necessary, a verdict is the harm — deprogramming, exit counselling, and the in-between time.
The Western esoteric tradition ran the same induction, named the same failure and built the same safeguards into a syllabus — and published its own predation account.
The case studies, opening: one mechanism in four environments — and the finding that the environment sets the price, not whether the move is used.
The method: what a predator never has to build, because the surrounding culture already built it — an inventory of pre-supplied levers.
Hidden agency: a cosmology in which harm is real but invisible and suffering is a debt — the unfalsifiable slot, pre-supplied.
Ranked inner state: enlightenment as a hierarchy nobody can check — and why wanting the next rung is obedience.
The state itself: where dissociation is already holy, the damage arrives pre-legitimised and the alarm is off.
The destination: a host culture certifies the teacher before he arrives — and the check on him reads as bigotry.
The same mechanism outside Brazil: a guru who taught emptying the self and being filled with him — in a tradition that had already named the state and called it not the goal.
An environment that supplies nothing: post-Soviet Ukraine, the vacuum, and the group that filled it — the same mechanism as Brazil and Japan, at a different price.
The one case where the group did not find a dissociation but designed one: a technique written to produce the state on schedule, then read as the goal.
The same manufactured collapse with no mysticism at all: est and the Landmark Forum — fatigue, confrontation, the state, and the appraisal sold as “Transformation.”
The mechanism's third route: the same state appraised as breakthrough or bad trip — and “set and setting” is the frame lever, named by the field as a risk factor.
A first-person account: a practitioner describes the environment that supplies the frame, reports being recruited and getting out — and contradicts this series where it matters most.
